description: This PHP source file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema, which manages configuration directives, namespaces, and related schema aspects for the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for adding directives, namespaces, aliases, and value constraints, as well as serializing and singleton management.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema
classes.description: Manages the schema for configuration directives and their defaults in the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: makeFromSerial
methods.description: Unserializes and returns a saved instance of the configuration schema.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the singleton instance of the schema.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Defines a configuration directive within a namespace with a default value, type, and null allowance.

methods.name: addNamespace
methods.description: Defines a new namespace for directives.

methods.name: addValueAliases
methods.description: Adds a set of value aliases for a directive.

methods.name: addAllowedValues
methods.description: Sets allowed values for a directive.

methods.name: addAlias
methods.description: Creates an alias for a directive.

methods.name: postProcess
methods.description: Converts stdclass definitions with only type information into integers for internal optimization.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Deprecated: Parses a value using HTMLPurifier_VarParser class.
